name: Online Records
author: SWOS United (SWOS 2020's challenge and speedrun records)
about: SWOS 2020's challenge and speedrun records, read from sensiblesoccer.de: who has beaten a challenge, the completion, the leaderboards, your records, the latest runs, the shared custom challenges. Nothing is sent there: your wins and runs stay your own until SWOS United's own server takes them.
